semantics.identity_rule: Each inference request has an explicit identity.
semantics.surface_rule: q, qc and qt surfaces remain distinct identities/semantics.
semantics.target_rule: q/qc target is explicit and never inferred from editor focus/cwd.
semantics.context_rule: Memory/context/tool inputs are explicit provenance-bearing inputs.
semantics.inert_rule: Request creation has no domain effect.
semantics.authority_rule: Model request cannot expand caller authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
